summary: Hold the viewer child so the app can close it on exit and answer about its own viewer

coordination.notes: Extends the existing owner: launch_viewer keeps being the one launcher and now keeps what it launched, and viewer_status keeps being the one status. The kill is by the handle this app created, never by image name - several sessions on this machine run their own viewers and a name-based kill would take theirs. Committed together with B6 because both edit ViewerStatus in viewer.rs and splitting the hunks would have produced two commits neither of which compiles.

checks: cargo test --lib -> 116 passed (4 new here, including one that spawns a real child, holds it, closes it and asserts the slot is cleared)

in the running app: Open viewer -> viewer pid 37360, panel reads 'open' (the held-child answer); app closed with WM_CLOSE -> tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq DRCompanionWorldViewer.exe" -> 'INFO: No tasks are running which match the specified criteria.'

sabotage: the RunEvent::Exit branch disabled with `if false &&`, rebuilt, viewer opened (pid 20836), app closed the same way -> 'viewer SURVIVED the app: True pid 20836'. Restored, md5sum -c matched a7803244a3b6d5fc9b3dfd4d0b3c6b0d, and the orphan was killed by that pid. Without this the earlier pass was only evidence that the viewer was gone, not that this code closed it.
